name: adoptalove
description: AdoptaLove compatible con OpenAI Sites mediante Next.js y OpenNext.

scripts.build: next build --webpack && opennextjs-cloudflare build --skipNextBuild && node scripts/package-sites-dist.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.install:legacy: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
